import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
results = []
for name in ['process-moved', 'tree-added-process']:
    fixture = base / ('churn-' + name)
    fixture.mkdir()
    process = None
    writer = None
    try:
        root = fixture / 'cgroups'
        owned = root / 'owned'
        proc = fixture / 'proc'
        member = proc / '41'
        owned.mkdir(parents=True)
        member.mkdir(parents=True)
        (owned / 'cgroup.procs').write_text('41\n')
        (member / 'cgroup').write_bytes(b'0::/owned\n')
        os.mkfifo(member / 'status')
        command = ['java', '-Djava.io.tmpdir=' + str(base), '-cp', str(base / 'sampler-classes'),
                   'SamplerProbe', str(root), str(proc), str(owned)]
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 10
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            try:
                writer = os.open(member / 'status', os.O_WRONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK)
                break
            except OSError as failure:
                if failure.errno != 6:
                    raise
                if process.poll() is not None:
                    raise RuntimeError('Sampler exited before blocked status read')
                time.sleep(0.01)
        if writer is None:
            raise TimeoutError('Sampler did not reach blocked status read')
        if name == 'process-moved':
            (member / 'cgroup').write_bytes(b'0::/other\n')
            expected = 'Process does not report the expected exact unified membership record'
        else:
            (owned / 'cgroup.procs').write_text('41\n42\n')
            expected = 'Owned process membership changed while sampling'
        os.write(writer, b'VmRSS: 1 kB\n')
        os.close(writer)
        writer = None
        stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        passed = (process.returncode == 1) and (stdout == '') and (expected in stderr)
        results.append(dict(case=name, command=command, barrier='status FIFO writer open proves reader reached RSS read',
                            mutation_before_status_delivery=True, exit=process.returncode, stdout=stdout,
                            stderr=stderr, passed=passed))
        print(name + ': ' + ('PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'))
    finally:
        if writer is not None:
            os.close(writer)
        if process is not None:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.kill()
            process.communicate(timeout=10)
        shutil.rmtree(fixture)
(base / 'sampler-churn-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')
if all(item['passed'] for item in results) is False:
    raise SystemExit(1)
